question: How many therapy minutes and hours did Rowan actually receive during the review period, overall and for each Monday–Sunday week? Show calculations or supporting detail, and report any conclusion the available documents do not settle.

plan.reading: "Therapy minutes actually received" means the minutes of held contacts where the patient was present, in the classes the plan counts. Hours are those minutes divided by 60. The breakdown uses Monday–Sunday weeks across the plan period.
other_readings: Count every held contact, including classes the plan excludes.
Count scheduled or billed minutes, not documented delivered minutes.
plan.notes: The question gives only the first name "Rowan". The only match is HG-M042, Rowan Mercer. The plan ends on Friday 2026-01-30, so the last Monday–Sunday week is partly covered.
